references.text: Describes Israel's victory over Sihon, king of the Amorites who ruled in Heshbon, the same area mentioned in Joshua 12:2
Mentions the Arnon River as a boundary, the same geographical marker as in Joshua 12:2
Parallel account of the victory over Sihon and his territory from Aroer by the Arnon River
Refers to half of Gilead taken from Sihon, the same area mentioned in Joshua 12:2
Confirms Heshbon as Sihon's capital and his role as king of the Amorites
Jephthah refers to Israel's conquest of Sihon's land from Arnon to Jabbok, the same boundaries as in Joshua 12:2
Describes the distribution of Sihon's kingdom, including the Gilead region
The Jabbok River is mentioned as a boundary, the same river that marks the northern border in Joshua 12:2
